content.value_statement: Approved creator content often stalls after the first organic post. This skill turns it into paid amplification plans, reusable UGC assets, and rights-aware calendars.
actual_capabilities: Scores approved creator posts and ranks which assets deserve paid spend.
Builds Spark Ads, Partnership Ads, boosting, and dark post amplification plans.
Allocates campaign budget by content, objective, platform, and pacing phase.
Maps one UGC asset into many channel-ready formats for ads, web, email, and social.
Creates rights-tracked asset inventories with expiration and approved-use fields.
Produces optimization playbooks with KPI targets, scale rules, and pause rules.
limitations: It assumes the creator content is already approved and cleared for use.
It does not replace legal review, FTC disclosure review, or claim substantiation.
It needs user-supplied metrics or optional connectors for live performance data.
It cannot process raw audio or video without transcripts, captions, or described assets.

use_cases.title: Select posts for paid boost
use_cases.description: A growth marketer ranks creator posts, assigns spend, and plans platform-specific setup steps.

use_cases.title: Turn one creator video into many assets
use_cases.description: A content lead converts a strong TikTok into ads, website proof, email content, and social posts.

use_cases.title: Track UGC rights before reuse
use_cases.description: An influencer manager records approved uses, expiration dates, and renewal actions before repurposing assets.

prompt_templates.title: Pick content to amplify
prompt_templates.prompt: Use content-amplifier in paid mode. I have these creator posts, metrics, platforms, objective, and budget: [paste details]. Rank what to amplify and allocate spend.

prompt_templates.title: Build a repurposing map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use content-amplifier in repurpose mode. I have these approved UGC assets and rights terms: [paste assets]. Create a channel map, format specs, and 30-day rollout.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Spark Ads and Partnership Ads
prompt_templates.prompt: Use content-amplifier in paid mode for TikTok and Instagram. Include authorization steps, audience structure, exclusions, KPI targets, and scale or pause rules.

prompt_templates.title: Build a rights-aware UGC library
prompt_templates.prompt: Use content-amplifier in repurpose mode. Create a naming convention, metadata fields, rights tracker, expiration alerts, and reuse rules for this UGC library: [paste inventory].

output_examples.input: Five approved TikTok videos, a 5000 USD budget, and a traffic objective.
output_examples.output: A ranked amplification scorecard, spend by creator, Spark Ads setup priorities, audience plan, and three-day learning phase rules.

output_examples.input: Three creator videos with full rights for web, email, paid, and organic social.
output_examples.output: A repurposing plan that turns the best video into ads, quote cards, website proof, email creative, and a dated rollout calendar.

output_examples.input: A UGC library with mixed paid, organic-only, and expiring rights.
output_examples.output: A rights matrix, reuse restrictions, renewal actions, and a safe channel plan that avoids unapproved paid usage.

best_practices: Provide real performance metrics and label any estimates before budget planning.
Confirm usage rights and expiration dates before recommending paid, website, or email reuse.
Run content-reviewer first when claims, disclosures, or brand safety have not been approved.
anti_patterns: Do not amplify content only because production quality is high.
Do not reuse organic-only assets in paid ads or owned channels.
Do not treat estimated CPM, ROAS, or rights data as measured facts.

faq.question: Does this skill review creator content for compliance?
faq.answer: No. It works after content is approved. Use content-reviewer for disclosure, claim, and brand-safety gates.

faq.question: Can it work without ad platform connectors?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use pasted metrics and label missing values as estimated or unavailable.

faq.question: What platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It covers common paid and organic workflows for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, websites, email, and social channels.

faq.question: Can it create finished video edits?
faq.answer: No. It creates transformation specs, asset maps, and calendars. Editors still produce the final creative files.

faq.question: How does it handle usage rights?
faq.answer: It records rights levels, approved uses, expiration dates, and renewal actions before recommending reuse.

faq.question: When should I use paid mode versus repurpose mode?
faq.answer: Use paid mode to allocate media spend. Use repurpose mode to turn approved UGC into many channel-specific assets.
